Charles A. Salerno, Tallahassee, attorney for petitioner.

Charles R. Fawsett, Orlando, attorney for respondent.

A secret ballot election was conducted November 16, 1992, in
the following unit:

INCLUDED: All full-time, sworn certified police
officers, including probationary
employees, employed by the City of West
Melbourne..

EXCLUDED: Chief of Police, all personnel employed
in the City of West Melbourne Police
Department of the rank of corporal and
above, and all other employees of the
City of West Melbourne.

The election results are as follows:

1. Approximate number of eligible voters 13
2. Void ballots 9
3. Votes cast for Petitioner 7
4. Votes cast against participating
organization 6 __

5. Valid votes counted 13
6. Challenged ballots 0
7. Valid votes counted plus challenged ballots 13

8. Challenges are not sufficient to affect the
results of the election.

9949

RC-92-039

The Commission VERIFIES the results of the election con-
ducted November 16, 1992, Petitioner (OR-86-150) received a
majority of the valid votes plus challenged ballots.

Pursuant to Section 447.307(3}(b), Florida Statutes, the
Commission CERTIFIES the Petitioner as the exclusive bargaining
representative for employees in the unit described above.
Certification number _999 is issued to the Petitioner,

It is so ordered.
HORNE, Chairman, SLOAN and MUNROE, Commissioners, concur.
